about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Lighter Labs tracking Rivian Automotive, Inc. / DE (RIVN), with pricing referencing Lighter fair price oracle (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Rivian Automotive, Inc. / DE share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Lighter ZK-rollup (Ethereum).
